subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should OpenClaw support Home-based Wear agent, session, and model switching as the canonical navigation model, with `model-controls` and model RPCs as the companion compatibility contract?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow repair: it removes existing navigation surfaces and introduces persistent cross-version protocol behavior, so code review alone cannot choose the intended product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the Home workflow
options.body: Approve the three-page Wear navigation and capability-gated model-control protocol, then proceed with ordinary Android/Wear merge review.

options.title: Keep current navigation
options.body: Retain separate Agent and Session pages and close or narrow the PR rather than establishing the new model-control protocol.

options.title: Request a narrower UX proposal
options.body: Ask for an owner-defined navigation design before adding model selection or removing pages.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Home workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the three-page Wear navigation and capability-gated model-control protocol, then proceed with ordinary Android/Wear merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: The only identified person connected to this proposed Android/Wear design is its current implementation contact; the repository-history owner trail could not be verified here.
